note: Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is on disk whole (ebible mirror gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/amh_amh). The mirror carries no Old Testament, so OT quotations reuse the wording of an already-shipped Amharic work only where it is truly the same verse, and are otherwise self_rendered in the 1962 register.

Rows come from the translators' reports; every 'mined' claim was re-verified: each quoted fragment must be a byte-exact substring of both its chapter and the 1962 NT text, else it is recorded as self_rendered. The mirror bridges some verse ranges into one entry holding only part of their text, so verses inside those ranges are self_rendered.
